assets/emoji-picker.worker-<hash>.js.rationale: The measured 400,601 B raw / 68,523 B gzip demand-loaded search worker owns Fuse plus the complete Unicode and keyword catalogs. It is fetched only after a query and replaces the measured 166 ms synchronous full-catalog route search with 150 ms debounce, physical replacement, a three-second deadline, exact query/result bounds, and a 4x-CPU main-thread responsiveness gate.

assets/docker-converter.worker-<hash>.js.rationale: The measured 206,522 B raw / 63,261 B gzip route-owned worker contains the existing composerize-ts path plus YAML parsing for the new reverse Compose-to-run direction. Both directions share strict 16 KiB live, 256 KiB input, 512 KiB output, message-count/size, four-second, cancellation, stale-result, and disposal bounds; the worker remains demand-loaded and below the 500 kB chunk gate.

assets/cron-next-runs.worker-<hash>.js.rationale: The measured 8,957 B raw / 3,837 B gzip route-owned worker computes at most 25 timezone-aware Unix, seconds, or Quartz runs within a five-year horizon, with an eight-second deadline and physical cancellation outside the main thread.

assets/file-hash.worker-<hash>.js.rationale: The dedicated demand-loaded worker includes streaming SHA-2, SHA-3, BLAKE3, SHA-1, and MD5 implementations for interoperability without affecting the initial shell. The measured worker is 25,899 B raw / 10,417 B gzip; this narrow ceiling still prevents accidental parser or whole-library growth independently of its route closure.

assets/hash-text.worker-<hash>.js.rationale: The measured 60,239 B raw / 21,154 B gzip route-owned worker computes the existing eight CryptoJS digests outside the main thread. It replaces a measured 706 ms Node / 2.95 s production-browser reactive 1 MiB main-thread path with 16 KiB automatic, 1 MiB hard input, five-second, cancellation, stale-result, and disposal bounds.

assets/html-wysiwyg-editor.worker-<hash>.rationale: The measured 212,679 B raw / 70,280 B gzip demand-loaded worker contains the existing Prettier HTML formatter plus strict task transport. Moving this work out of the route's main thread shrank the route chunk from 493,145 B / 153,634 B to 287,982 B / 86,389 B while adding cancellation, timeout, and input/output bounds.

assets/json-diff.worker-<hash>.js.rationale: The measured 33,844 B raw / 10,393 B gzip route-owned worker parses JSON5 once, enforces byte/depth/input/output bounds, and performs bounded key-aware/LCS alignment outside the main thread.

assets/json-converter.worker-<hash>.js.rationale: The measured 89,752 B raw / 27,405 B gzip demand-loaded worker parses JSON5 once and converts to TOML or YAML under shared byte/output/time limits; both JSON-source routes reuse the artifact without entering the shell.

assets/json-to-csv.worker-<hash>.js.rationale: The measured 30,443 B raw / 9,203 B gzip route-owned worker parses JSON5 once and performs incremental standard CSV generation under 64 KiB automatic, 1 MiB input, 2 MiB output, four-times amplification, eight-second, cancellation, stale-result, and disposal bounds.

assets/list-converter.worker-<hash>.js.rationale: The measured 4,097 B raw / 1,752 B gzip route-owned worker moves the measured large-list transform off the main thread and enforces bounded option strings, 64 KiB automatic, 1 MiB input, 2 MiB output, four-times amplification, timeout, replacement, and disposal contracts.

assets/mock-data-generator.worker-<hash>.rationale: The measured 7,058 B raw / 3,299 B gzip route-owned worker holds the versioned English mock dataset and deterministic generator under 5,000-record, 2 MiB output, eight-second, cancellation, and disposal bounds.

assets/markdown-to-html.worker-<hash>.js.rationale: The measured 104,960 B raw / 46,785 B gzip route-owned worker contains markdown-it plus bounded rendering transport and keeps large Markdown processing off the main thread.

assets/math-evaluator.worker-<hash>.js.rationale: The measured 354,052 B raw / 103,844 B gzip route-owned worker uses mathjs's number-only entry instead of the former full 623,620 B / 180,069 B route closure and enforces expression/output/time limits.

assets/sql-prettify.worker-<hash>.js.rationale: The measured 213,258 B raw / 56,829 B gzip route-owned worker contains sql-formatter and bounded dialect/options processing without running it reactively on the main thread.

assets/sensitive-data-masker.worker-<has.rationale: The measured 5,740 B raw / 2,499 B gzip route-owned worker sanitizes bounded text, JSON, and HAR documents with depth/node/input/output limits and a ten-second terminate-and-replace lifecycle; sensitive source content never enters persistence or transport.

assets/text-statistics.worker-<hash>.js.rationale: The measured 2,301 B raw / 1,144 B gzip route-owned worker moves the existing O(n), O(1)-space pass off the main thread for large text while retaining a narrow regression ceiling.

assets/toml-converter.worker-<hash>.js.rationale: The measured 89,835 B raw / 23,818 B gzip demand-loaded worker contains the existing TOML parser plus JSON/YAML writers and replaces duplicate validation/reactive parsing in both TOML-source routes.

assets/xml-formatter.worker-<hash>.js.rationale: The measured 7,486 B raw / 3,031 B gzip route-owned worker contains the XML formatter plus bounded task transport and preserves the vertical editor contract.

assets/xml-data-converter.worker-<hash>..rationale: The measured 92,312 B raw / 28,468 B gzip demand-loaded worker contains xml-js plus JSON5 and replaces duplicate reactive validation/transformation in both XML-to-JSON and JSON-to-XML routes under the shared bounded converter lifecycle.

assets/yaml-converter.worker-<hash>.js.rationale: The measured 109,980 B raw / 32,749 B gzip demand-loaded worker parses YAML once per task and converts to JSON or TOML under shared lifecycle and output limits; both YAML-source routes reuse it.

src/tools/file-hash/file-hash.vue.rationale: Bounded third catalog feature; this route-owned closure includes the incremental SHA-2 worker and must remain a small demand-loaded tool.

src/tools/emoji-picker/emoji-picker.vue.rationale: The measured additional closure is 680,300 B raw / 104,121 B gzip because the demand-loaded worker deliberately owns the complete compressible Unicode/keyword catalogs. Initial shell and initial emoji route rendering remain paged; the worker is fetched only after search and has a separate asset ceiling.

src/tools/html-wysiwyg-editor/html-wysiw.rationale: Bounded Tiptap route plus its demand-loaded Prettier worker. The measured additional closure is 551,423 B raw / 176,574 B gzip versus 541,545 B / 172,634 B before worker isolation; the 1.8% / 2.3% increase buys physical cancellation, an 8-second deadline, stale-result protection, and 64 KiB automatic / 1 MiB hard formatting bounds without increasing the initial shell or creating a chunk above 500 kB.

src/tools/mac-address-lookup/mac-address.rationale: Privacy-safe fixed-URL worker keeps the entered MAC prefix out of network logs and is 27% smaller than the former monolith; the separate 250 kB product target remains open.

src/tools/math-evaluator/math-evaluator..rationale: The measured 363,883 B raw / 108,586 B gzip route closure now owns a number-only mathjs worker with debounce, explicit large-input evaluation, a two-second deadline, and expression/output bounds; the prior full reactive closure was 623,620 B / 180,069 B.

src/tools/pdf-signature-checker/pdf-sign.rationale: Existing PDF/signature parser path; approved only as a no-regression ceiling.

src/tools/text-diff/text-diff.vue.rationale: Schema-v4 closure includes the existing route-owned Monaco editor worker; the measured CodeMirror decision and the 350 kB product target remain open.
